questions.question: Which country is the most polluted in 2024 and what is India's rank as per the recently revealed 2024 Air Pollution Rankings by IQAir?

options.text: Democratic Republic of Congo, India at 4th

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Chad and India's Rank is 5th.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Chad is the most polluted country in 2024__, with pollution levels over 15 times higher than WHO guidelines.**
 
• **__India ranks fifth in global pollution rankings__, with Byrnihat being the most polluted city in India, registering a PM2.5 level of 128 mg/cu m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chad has the highest pollution levels in 2024, exceeding WHO guidelines by more than 15 times.**
 
• India ranks fifth in global pollution levels with an average PM2.5 level of 50.6 mg/cu m in 2024.
 
• Byrnihat, an industrialized city in India's northeast, recorded the highest PM2.5 level of 128 mg/cu m in the country.
 
• Climate change is increasing the pollution levels due to higher temperatures and prolonged forest fires, impacting various regions globally.
 
• Swiss company IQAir’s 2024 World Air Quality Report revealed this.
 
• **India was 5th in the smog rankings behind Chad, Bangladesh, Pakistan & Democratic Republic of Congo.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• PM2.5:__ A measure of fine particulate matter in the air, less than 2.5 micrometers in diameter, which can be hazardous to health.
 
• __WHO Guidelines:__ World Health Organization's recommended safe levels for air quality, which is set at a maximum of 5 micrograms per cubic meter for PM2.5.
 
• __Byrnihat:__ A city in the northeastern part of India known for its industrial activity, contributing to high pollution levels.
 
• __Climate Change:__ A major driver of increased pollution, with higher temperatures fueling more intense and prolonged forest fires, which in turn increases air pollution levels.

questions.question: Which state has topped the State Food Safety Index (SFSI) 2024?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kerala secured the first position in the State Food Safety Index (SFSI) for 2024.**
 
• This marks the second consecutive year that Kerala has topped the index.
 
• The state previously ranked first in 2023, replacing Tamil Nadu.
 
• In 2024, the following states ranked after Kerala: **Tamil Nadu, Jammu & Kashmir, Gujarat, and Nagaland.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The Food Safety Index evaluates states based on their food safety norms and implementation.
 
• Parameters evaluated include **human resources, compliance, food testing facilities, and consumer empowerment.**
 
• Kerala's success is attributed to the efforts of its food safety department and various training initiatives.

questions.question: Which states lead the Fiscal Health Index (FHI) 2025?

options.text: Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, Punjab, Rajasthan, Haryana
Tamil Nadu, Kerala, West Bengal, Madhya Pradesh, Delhi
Karnataka, Rajasthan, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Bihar

questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Goa, Jharkhand, Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Fiscal Health Index 2025: Mapping India's State-Level Economic Resilience.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Purpose of FHI:** The Fiscal Health Index (FHI) by NITI Aayog aims to assess the fiscal health of Indian states, based on their contribution to GDP, demography, public expenditure, revenues, and fiscal stability.

 
 
• 
 
**Leading States:** Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Goa, Jharkhand, and Gujarat lead the Fiscal Health Index as of the latest report.

 
 
• 
 
**States’ Role in Economy:** States are responsible for about two-thirds of public spending and one-third of total revenue, making their fiscal performance crucial for India's overall economic stability.

 
 
• 
 
**Data Source:** The FHI is developed using data from the Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG) for the financial year 2022-23.

 
 
• 
 
**Debt Sustainability:** Focuses on the state's ability to meet both current and future debt obligations without defaulting, considering both solvency and liquidity.

 
 
• 
 
**Debt Index:** The Debt Index is the ratio of Interest Payments to Revenue Receipts (IP/RR), indicating the percentage of revenue spent on servicing debt.

 
 
• 
 
**Fiscal Health Evaluation:** The FHI provides a composite index to objectively evaluate each state's fiscal health, enabling comparisons with best practices and other states.

questions.question: What is India's ranking in the 2025 World Press Freedom Index?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**151st.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India ranks 151st in the 2025 World Press Freedom Index, showing a slight improvement from 159th in 2024.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **India ranks 151st in the 2025 World Press Freedom Index, improving from 159th in 2024.**
 
• The report highlights significant threats to press freedom in India, including financial instability among media outlets.
 
• Many media outlets in India have shut down due to economic hardship, further limiting press freedom.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• World Press Freedom Index__

 __
 
• The World Press Freedom Index is compiled by Reporters Without Borders, evaluating the press freedom situation in 180 countries.
 
• It measures the degree of freedom available to journalists in each country and the dangers they face in reporting the news.
 
 
 
• Press Freedom Threats__
 
 
• Press freedom faces significant challenges globally, including economic pressures, violence against journalists, and government censorship.

questions.question: India ranks in which position in the Future of Free Speech 2025 study among 33 countries?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is__** ​24th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India ranks 24th in global free speech study amid rising restriction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **India** ranks **24th** on the **Future of Free Speech** list with an overall score of **62.63**.
 
• The study was conducted by **The Future of Free Speech**, an independent think tank based at **Vanderbilt University**, USA.
 
• The study reports a global trend of increasing **free speech restrictions**, often referred to as a **"free speech recession."**
 
• **Scandinavian countries** (Norway, Denmark, and Sweden) and **Hungary** and **Venezuela** top the list for highest support for free speech.
 
• **Muslim-majority countries** and the **Global South** show the **lowest levels of support** for free speech.
 
• The study was conducted in **October 2024**, based on a previous survey from **2021**.

questions.question: What is the name of the report published by UNICEF that highlights trends in global child mortality in 2022?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Levels and Trends in Child Mortality.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The "Levels and Trends in Child Mortality" report published by UNICEF highlights significant decreases in global child mortality in 2022.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The report highlights 4.9 million child deaths in 2022, reflecting a decrease in the global under-five mortality rate (U5MR) since 2000.**
 
• **2.3 million of these deaths occurred in the first month of life, while 2.1 million youth aged 5–24 died in 2022.**
 
• **The report also emphasizes the inequality in survival chances, especially in Sub-Saharan Africa.**
 
• **It projects that 35 million under-five deaths will occur in Sub-Saharan Africa by 2030.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Under-five Mortality Rate (U5MR)__

 __
 
• Refers to the number of children who die before reaching five years of age, per 1,000 live births.
 
• A key indicator of child health and development in countries worldwide.
 
 
 
• Sub-Saharan Africa__
 
 
• Region where mortality rates for children under five are highest, influenced by factors like poverty, lack of healthcare, and conflict.

questions.question: What is India's rank in the Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI) 2024, and which country has topped the list?

options.text: India's rank is 96th, and Denmark topped the list
India's rank is 96th, and Finland topped the list
India's rank is 93rd, and Denmark topped the list
India's rank is 93rd, and Finland topped the list

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**India's rank is 96th, and Denmark topped the list.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India ranks 96th with a score of 38 in the CPI 2024, while Denmark has topped the list with a score of 90.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **India's rank dropped to 96th with a score of 38 in 2024, down from 93rd in 2023.**
 
• Denmark remains at the top of the CPI list for the seventh consecutive year with a score of 90.
 
• The global average CPI score is 43, with more than two-thirds of countries scoring below 50, indicating significant corruption levels.
 
• South Sudan, Somalia, and Venezuela are among the worst performers in the CPI 2024.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• CPI (Corruption Perceptions Index)__

 __
 
• The CPI is released by **Transparency International **and ranks countries based on perceived levels of public sector corruption.
 
• The index uses a scale of 0 (high corruption) to 100 (low corruption).
 
 
 
• Top and Bottom Performers__
 __
 
• Denmark has been the top performer for seven consecutive years with a score of 90 in 2024.
 
• South Sudan, Somalia, and Venezuela are ranked at the bottom of the index.
 
 
 
• India's Performance__
 __
 
• India ranks 96th with a score of 38, which reflects a decline in its position from 2023 (93rd) and 2022 (40th).
 
 
 
• **Regional Comparison (South Asia)**__
 
 
• China: Rank 76, Score 42
 
• Sri Lanka: Rank 121, Score 32
 
• Pakistan: Rank 135, Score 27
 
• Bangladesh: Rank 149, Score 23
 
• Afghanistan: Rank 165, Score 17
